name: ioctl_fideduperange
synopsis: int ioctl(int src_fd, FIDEDUPERANGE, struct file_dedupe_range *arg);
description: This ioctl allows sharing physical storage between files by deduplicating identical data ranges on the same filesystem, reducing storage consumption through copy-on-write behavior. It compares and shares data from a source file to one or more destination files if the data is identical.

parameters.name: src_fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the source file, which must be open for reading.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ioctl request code, typically FIDEDUPERANGE.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing deduplication information, including source offset, length, and an array of destination details.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: src_fd is not open for reading; dest_fd is not open for writing or is open for append-only writes; or the filesystem which src_fd resides on does not support deduplication.

The filesystem does not support deduplicating the ranges of the given files; this can occur if file descriptors represent devices, FIFOs, or sockets, or if offsets and lengths are not aligned properly.
One of the files is a directory and the filesystem does not support shared regions in directories.
The kernel was unable to allocate sufficient memory to perform the operation or dest_count is too large.
The filesystem does not support deduplicating either file descriptor, or if either refers to special inodes.
One of the files is a swap file, which cannot share storage.
dest_fd and src_fd are not on the same mounted filesystem.
